The [[Eldritch Sword]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] obtained from the [[Eldritch Chest]], which spawns  after defeating the [[Eldritch Ettin]] in [[Bloodstone Caves]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as an [[Aureate Blade]] [[dye]]d yellow.
